strong_rules: own number heading or closing tag on the pages (an OCR-damaged or mid-line heading only with a text score >= 0.6; in a compilation that prints no numbers, the signing date), text fingerprint score >= 0.5, distinctive fingerprint (>= 8 rare shingles), government-printed source, and no planted control failed this run
what_this_is_not: No status, identity, census, codebook or readiness change. Strong finds are machine locations; the tracker counts them only after this job is registered there.
